headline: See relationship risk before outreach becomes reactive
capabilities: Analyze sentiment across all customer touchpoints
Score churn risk by unifying sentiment, behavior, and all activity
Identify the customers most likely to leave and most valuable to retain
Generate targeted retention strategies and recommended outreach plans
outcomes: Empowered relationship managers with personalized resources
Protected revenue and reduced replacement costs
why_try: A relationship manager can ask who needs attention, see the exact synthetic signals behind the priority, and prepare outreach options without treating a score as a fact.

sample_prompts.label: Cross-channel sentiment view
sample_prompts.prompt: Analyze customer sentiment across our banking portfolio and identify accounts at highest churn risk.

sample_prompts.label: Churn-review prioritization
sample_prompts.prompt: Show me profiles of our highest-value at-risk customers.

sample_prompts.label: Retention option preparation
sample_prompts.prompt: Prepare options for Marcus that I can review before anyone contacts him or changes a fee.

sample_prompts.label: Segment context
sample_prompts.prompt: Which segment is under its experience benchmark, and what should we investigate?

sample_prompts.label: Early warning signals
sample_prompts.prompt: Yes, what are the early warning signals we should watch for?

sample_prompts.label: Outreach assignment plan
sample_prompts.prompt: Yes, assign the outreach and set up tracking.

business_flow: Customer Sentiment and Churn Prediction Agent
Approved voice, chat, survey, and complaint analytics
